verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Capacities has automatic daily notes uniquely linked to each day (capacities-docs-21, capacities-docs-43, capacities-docs-8) and a general templating system that can prefill properties/blocks of objects (capacities-docs-9), with community praise calling the daily notes implementation 'very nice' (capacities-comm-4). However, there is no explicit evidence that daily notes specifically support template pre-fill or that the daily note is set as the app's default landing/capture surface. Missing for 10: explicit documentation linking templates to daily notes, and confirmation that daily note is the default opening view for capture.
